source: Zetaris Lightning 2.4.3.1 (local), USL lightning.metastore.causeway_ns.causeway, read over REST
note: Business ledgers are SYNTHETIC (labelled). Driver series are real Eurostat data (re-use with attribution).

business.sql: SELECT business_id, name, city, nace, sector, synthetic FROM lightning.metastore.causeway_ns.causeway.business ORDER BY business_id

calendar_month.sql: SELECT period, easter_date, easter_share, days_in_month FROM lightning.metastore.causeway_ns.causeway.calendar_month ORDER BY period

driver_series.sql: SELECT series_id, dataset, label, unit_label, source_grain, licence FROM lightning.metastore.causeway_ns.causeway.driver_series ORDER BY series_id

business_period.sql: SELECT row_key, business_id, period, units, transactions, revenue, cogs, gross_margin_pct, avg_ticket, synthetic FROM lightning.metastore.causeway_ns.causeway.business_period ORDER BY row_key

driver_month.sql: SELECT obs_key, series_id, period, value, source_period FROM lightning.metastore.causeway_ns.causeway.driver_month ORDER BY obs_key
